resolution.note: fix(ci): complete orphaned krn/gate check runs and rerun them from deliver (t-dwkrwej)

title: Complete orphaned krn/gate check runs from the finished Jenkins build
body:
Outcome: a krn/gate check run that GitHub still shows queued or in_progress after its Jenkins build finished is completed by the controller with the Jenkins result and its cause (`failed at stage <stage>: <cause>` or success), so deliver never waits on an orphaned check run.
Evidence 2026-11-06: PR-237 Jenkins build #1 FAILURE at 06:30 while GitHub check run stayed in_progress; main 5c83fd6 check run 127578776138 stuck in_progress after the outage.
Proof: a reconcile test with a captured Jenkins lastBuild (building:false, result FAILURE) and a GitHub check run in_progress for the same head produces one completion PATCH with conclusion failure; a still-building job produces none.
Operator 2026-11-06: "my mamy napierdalać rzeczy a nie kurwa ksztusić się na gejtach".
